pre-existing test files (report-pdf-endpoint, s5-negative) from even
running; full suite now 60/60 passing (was 25/30).

existed and are live — added /tos as a same-content alias per the brief's
literal route name, plus footer links.

feat(calhoun): add B/F auto-resolution to clerk harvester (shard-12 run-7076)

When calhounclerk.com WP REST API reports a closed sale status (sold/redeemed/
struck off/certificate issued/completed), the harvester now:
  1. Sets auction_status='completed', sold_amount, tier1_sold_amount on MCA row

     data_source='calhoun_clerk_wp_api:CALHOUN-BF-V1' (B criterion: independent)
  3. Calls pencil_dod_evaluate_county('calhoun') and prints post-harvest score

currently upcoming/cancelled per verified live DB + clerk API, consistent with
the d0d45cbc shard-10 session). This wires the auto-resolver so 8/10 → 10/10
happens on the next 05:45 UTC cron run after the county posts its first sale,
with no manual session required.

Also adds: CLOSED_STATUSES set, is_closed() helper, build_outcome_rows(),
upsert_outcomes(), evaluate_county() — all consistent with existing patterns.
Fail-loud invariant preserved: parsed>0 AND inserted=0 raises RuntimeError.
